name: GD MCP
description: Full remote control of Geometry Dash over MCP: Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP client can change your icon/colors, click buttons, play levels and build/edit levels.

auto-start.name: Auto-start server
auto-start.description: Start the MCP server when the game launches.

port.name: Port
port.description: TCP port of the MCP server. Restart the game after changing.

bind-all.name: Listen on all interfaces
bind-all.description: OFF = only this device (127.0.0.1, use a tunnel for Claude/ChatGPT). ON = reachable from your LAN. Restart the game after changing.

token.name: Secret token
token.description: Required to talk to the server. Auto-generated on first launch (restart the game after changing). Use it as Bearer token or in the URL: /mcp/<token>. Keep it private!
